title: tenant-api chart values — top-level keys + writeBack
description: Catches a misspelled key at `helm template` / `helm install` instead of letting it be silently ignored (#1594). Constrains the TOP-LEVEL key set, the whole writeBack block, the rbac block, the oauth2Proxy block and networkPolicy.internalPortAllow (additionalProperties:false); every other block is left open. The top-level machineIdentity and humanSocket keys and the internalPortAllow recipePreview / daPortal entries were removed with ADR-027 §4–§6, so a values file still carrying one fails the render. The rbac block admits only _rbacYaml: the scope-axis switches (metadataScopeEnforce, metadataWriteScopeEnforce, orgScopeEnforce) were removed with ADR-027 §7, and a values file still carrying one fails the render instead of being silently ignored (ADR-027 §6). Semantic checks stay in the templates' {{ fail }} guards on purpose, because their messages explain WHY a value is refused: writeBack.mode="" (unset) and every cross-field requirement of the PR modes are refused by tenant-api.writeBackGuard in templates/_helpers.tpl, so the schema admits "" and does not type directAcknowledgeNotDelivered (the guard accepts only the boolean true, and says so). Only the KEY sets, writeBack.mode's values and three oauth2Proxy leaves are constrained (clientID a string; claimHeaders claim names and header names to the charsets tenant-api accepts; cookieSameSite one of '', lax, strict, none, the spellings oauth2-proxy accepts); the other leaves are deliberately untyped (a numeric GitLab project id, an unquoted numeric branch name are legal and the templates handle them).

global.description: Helm's own key, present when this chart is used as a subchart. Not read by any template.

replicaCount.description: MUST stay 1 (ADR-023 single writer) — enforced by the fail guard in templates/deployment.yaml, not here.

mode.description: tenant-api --write-mode. "" is the shipped default and means unset: the render fails with the writeBack guard's explanation. The non-empty values are exactly the binary's legal --write-mode inputs (`pr` was retired as an input in #1594). Pinned by components/tenant-api/cmd/server/chart_schema_test.go.

directAcknowledgeNotDelivered.description: Only the boolean true acknowledges direct mode; the writeBack guard refuses anything else, including the string "true".

project.description: group/project path or numeric project id — a number is legal, the template renders it as an integer.
